title: Trading Blows GUI Progress
author: Tom_Baron
selftext:
I've spent longer on my GUI now than I did on my first game! 

Trading blows is a turn based full strategic and tactical war game

My vision for the GUI is any one of us is thrown behind a clandestine command terminal in a civil war, not long from now. Our resources are limited and our tools are cobbled together out of surplus kit. It works imperfectly! I want to be sparse on animation in the game itself aside from the action replay. This is a turn based game, the effect of jumping from strategic to tactical views should be jarring and uncomfortable for the player. Exposing them to the consequences of decisions made almost in a computer game.

Because us AI game devs can do anything our imagination can picture. I decided to animate my GUI to try to capture this vision. I especially like the theatre map dialog boxes popping up from a white dot, this is intentional and akin to an old CRT monitor turning on (those of you who can remember those, props!)

So I've still got lots of GUI work to do, trimming the old AI stuff out and smoothing workflows out, making everything ergonomic but it feels like my vision is starting to appear in game for the GUI anyway.
